items.title: Nodal quotients of a formal power series ring characterized by the (n-1)-minors of the Jacobian matrix
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes the nodal quotients A/I of a formal power series ring through the (n-1)-minors of the Jacobian matrix (statement lines 4311-4330). The proof (lines 4332-4388) is a hands-on normal-form argument: the unit-pivoting loop that strips the presentation down to two variables, the block-triangular estimate placing every minor in m_A^{n-1-t}, and the pinch t = n - 2 from Nakayama together with the exclusion of the invertible-minor cases, closing with the structure theorem for reduced quotients of a two-variable power series ring. H2: every step is elementary, but the pivoting bookkeeping and the final index computation must be kept straight and no step can be replaced by a citation.
